# CarlandFPGA project rules

- This repository contains a three-machine control plane and a separate PYNQ-Z2 single-machine development skill. On machine A, use `.agents/skills/pynq-z2-single-node/SKILL.md` for local design, verification, toolchain, and physical board work. On B/C, use the node-matched installed client skill ZIP for design and Git handoff; the repository copy includes A's board upload entrypoint and is not the client workflow. Use `fpga_mesh/` and `docs/deployment/OPERATIONS.md` for group coordination.
- The drilling-logging draft and attached skill packs are references. Do not treat AD7606, 300 bps, compression ratio, latency, Ryzen AI, or the final host application as settled requirements until a task version chooses them.
- In group work, only machine A may operate the physical board. B/C may design and simulate, then submit a code commit, test plan, and evidence manifest through a repository PR. A reports actual board results against that PR's operation ID, request hash, and tested commit.
- Keep simulation, synthesis, implementation, and actual PYNQ-Z2 measurements distinct. Preserve commands, tool versions, reports, logs, and artifact hashes; do not claim board results from a model or simulator.
- Keep project code and distributables inside this repository. Large vendor installers and board images may live outside it with recorded source and hash. Build the FPGA teammate ZIP from committed tracked files with `python -m fpga_mesh.distribution`; unrelated product packages and rules are outside this project.

## Autonomous routing v0.7 (2026-10-10)

- All GPT main conversations on a node use its existing Astra Feishu identity. All DeepSeek execution children use its existing DeepSeek identity. Permissions and human > main > child priority are unchanged; the main authorizes child group reports.
- For an independent task use `fpga_session_open`; followups use the registered task_id. Use `fpga_session_route` to choose an allowed GPT model/effort for the next turn. If these tools are not loaded, run the local Python entry point `-m fpga_mesh.project_cli` using `.local/venv/Scripts/python.exe`; `session_list`, `main_submit`, `main_wait`, `session_route` use the same resident controller. Payloads may be UTF-8 JSON files passed with `--args-file`. Never change global providers or copy credentials to accomplish routing.
- There is no default, minimum or prescribed number of subagents. Use none when delegation adds cost or risks quality; otherwise prefer the specified API-key DeepSeek Flash at fixed highest `max`, automatically allocated per assignment and dynamically reclaimable.
- Subagents exist to reduce GPT usage without lowering quality and to relieve main execution work. Decisions, acceptance, hard problems, key optimization and evaluation must be completed by the quality GPT main model at its highest available effort. Read allowed models/efforts from the running controller. Main model/effort changes apply between turns, never during generation.
- Both DeepSeek and native GPT assignments require stable task_id/task_version/work_id and explicit ownership for file writes. Reuse a duplicate job's result; do not launch a second executor. Overlapping file ownership cannot run concurrently.
- Native GPT subagents are allowed only for a stated special capability need. Before spawning, the parent calls `fpga_native_reserve`. If it returns duplicate=true, reuse the existing assignment and do not spawn. Pass the returned lease and the canonical child agent ID to the native child, which MUST call `fpga_native_validate` (or the CLI equivalent) and receive `execution_allowed=true` before any project execution, then `fpga_native_complete` with actual evidence. A native child without a valid bound lease must stop without executing. Native subagents cannot independently publish to Feishu or promote themselves to a main role.
- Do not replay interrupted/failed side effects automatically. Inspect persisted evidence, supersede the old task version or make a new explicit work assignment after the quality main decides how to recover.

## Official model updates v0.8 (2026-10-10)

- Main and native GPT inference use the builtin `openai` provider and this member's official Codex login. DeepSeek execution uses its separate direct API provider at fixed Flash/max. Do not introduce a local inference router, custom private catalog or cross-role credential copying.
- Use `fpga_models_refresh` or `project_cli models_refresh` to refresh the actual official model/effort catalog and native role files. The human update page opens with `deploy/更新官方模型.cmd`. Refresh makes no inference call and retains current tasks, leases and credentials. Newly discovered official visible models get native roles automatically; `official-latest` follows the official default. Missing legacy names remain explicitly documented aliases until listed by the official catalog.
- Role definitions apply to newly loaded conversations. An already generating turn keeps its model. Supported model access must be verified by actual completed turns; catalog membership alone is not an access guarantee.

## In-place distribution and Astra files (2026-10-11)

- Existing nodes use `deploy/Update-FPGAMesh.ps1`: update changed source files only, preserve local configuration/credentials/state, and do not rerun onboarding. The updater fences ledger admission and verifies idle before stopping the existing service.
- Astra requires tenant scope `im:resource` for file upload/readback. Astra-A received explicit human authorization and its grant was verified. Existing B/C must obtain their own app owner's authorization on the existing Astra app; an update ZIP cannot grant a cloud scope. Run `python -m fpga_mesh.feishu_permissions --config <existing-config>` for a read-only audit. Never add file scope to DeepSeek or change the human > main > child priority.

<!-- fpga-project-skills:begin -->
## Mandatory project skills

Every new conversation must read `.agents/skills/fpga-multi-node/SKILL.md` and its
node-matched role; use `.agents/skills/pynq-z2-single-node/SKILL.md` for local FPGA
design and verification. A alone operates the physical board. Both skills are
project-local; a new conversation loads the installed version.
Apply the existing human > main > child priority, task ownership and evidence
rules. Skills grant no new role, credentials, cloud scope or service authority.
Keep presence silent unless the human asks; report actual task blockers concisely.
The resident program handles waiting, without model polling.

Human update 2026-10-15: the responsible main autonomously creates, continues,
terminates and archives its work chats and selects any actually supported model
and reasoning effort without per-step permission. Desktop/native tasks use the
main's recorded assignment and exclusive file ownership; mesh leases govern only
jobs using that route. This replaces older fixed Flash/max, highest-effort and
native-special-capability prerequisites. Preserve H01-H15, sole active ownership,
actual termination checks and independent evidence review.
<!-- fpga-project-skills:end -->

<!-- deepeye-human-lock:begin -->
## Human-pinned DeepEye scope (2026-10-14)

For `COMP-20261013-DEEPEYE` planning, review, implementation and handoff, every
main, work conversation and child must first read and verify all H01-H15 in
`DEEPEYE-HUMAN-LOCK-20261014`, revision 1. Source commit:
`f5989cd5defce561f9ba98e6b18fc2682945f0a2`, files
`docs/competition/deepeye-2026/immutable_scope.md` and `immutable_scope.json`:
https://github.com/carolwjade/CarlandFPGA/tree/f5989cd5defce561f9ba98e6b18fc2682945f0a2/docs/competition/deepeye-2026

The SHA-256 of the UTF-8, sorted-key, compact JSON `requirements` array is
`c229834bfc2292f5fe4411fc9f12c68487008f9d1adaf31f0144ee7a98173804`.
Carry the contract ID, revision, source and hash into each work assignment and
handoff; verify with `verify_immutable_scope.py --expected-sha <the hash>`.
That check establishes requirement identity only, never product acceptance.

Preserve the complete interactive game-quality 3D application, edge-only hollow
cube, solid drill and obstacles with full-volume collision, free viewing,
editable/random water and hard-rock layouts, freely chosen entry/exit faces,
equal blue/red rings and whole-drill traversal. Keep initial truth hidden from
both PC control algorithms and FPGA; deliver only causal sensor observations
within documented real-device bounds. PC AI must actually perceive/map/plan;
both PC-direct and FPGA-executed control paths remain valid and separately
verified. These are mandatory final acceptance gates, with no 2D, video,
pre-recorded animation or schedule/budget-based scope replacement.

Only a new explicit instruction from the human can amend that scope. Preserve
the existing skills, evidence, ownership and A-only physical-board rules;
physical-board access is distinct from simulated-drill control authority.
Technical choices may improve within the complete H01-H15 scope. Record a real
blocker honestly and continue independent authorized work when necessary.
<!-- deepeye-human-lock:end -->

<!-- deepeye-implementation-tool-bridge:begin -->
## DeepEye implementation handoff tool bridge (2026-10-15)

A's final publication and START are recorded in
`.local/plan-20261014-final-c/A-START-source.json`. The sole frozen design is
`1011259415a0916054eb580687612580bc1e5f09`; the H01-H15 lock above is unchanged.
The group publication is already complete; see the actual platform/UI receipt
`.local/plan-20261014-final-c/feishu-final-publication-receipt.json`. Older queued
COMP publication requests are superseded evidence tasks: check this receipt and
the latest START, do not publish again. An old mesh turn must end after its own
handoff; do not hold its serial gateway lock in `main_wait` for the successor.

C's one registered implementation director is thread
`01a13b42-9716-79e2-9afc-271dc489c01e`, task
`DEEPEYE-IMPLEMENTATION-20261014/version1`. The old human desktop thread
`01a13af2-773c-7ef0-a556-32a4f2021f18` is only a handoff/tool proxy, not another
implementation director or product writer.

If the director's mesh context lacks App `create_thread`, follow A's verified
2026-10-14T16:41:28Z tool-availability update: the new director defines the exact
worker plan and reserves native leases, then writes the private request file
`.local/plan-20261014-final-c/worker_bridge_requests.json`. Include director ID,
frozen commit and lock hash, worker task/version/work_id, native job/token,
reason, exact ownership, a wait-for-binding-only initial prompt and the startup
prompt. The old desktop proxy creates actual App workers from that plan, binds
each real thread ID with native_validate, sends the self-validation startup,
and records actual IDs/validation results in `worker_bridge_results.json` in the
same directory. The new director remains responsible for decisions, Flash
assignments and verification. Ordinary source ownership belongs to its Flash
jobs, disjoint from each native context/notes lease. The new director may write
the request and its startup receipt there; the proxy owns bridge results.

Root remains mesh-registered once; parallel workers are real App threads, not
additional serial session_open entries. Do not change credentials, services,
providers or the immutable scope to work around tool availability. Private
bridge tokens, group metadata and SQLite evidence stay out of public artifacts.

For continuation after the old desktop ends, its tool-only role is delegated to
the actual App relay `01a13b7a-cda4-7e70-8f1e-ae1eea19e2df` (native lease
`child-f9d09f38678d48c4953d9df1bd55e36e`). This is not a product worker or second
director. Only the registered director authors requests and worker leases; the
relay executes that exact plan. `worker_bridge_results.json` and
`app-tool-proxy/` now belong exclusively to this relay. The director should read
the current `.local/plan-20261014-final-c/final-accepted.json` for live peer IDs
and interface progress as well as the original frozen publication evidence.
<!-- deepeye-implementation-tool-bridge:end -->

<!-- deepeye-current-human-main-20261015:begin -->
## Current human-designated C main (2026-10-15)

The human explicitly designated Desktop thread
`01a14025-4dfd-7ec3-aebb-57be48daba59` as C's current main for the same
`DEEPEYE-IMPLEMENTATION-20261014/version1`. Do not terminate, archive or replace
this main without a new explicit human instruction. Ending a model turn does
not close the chat. The frozen design and all H01-H15 above remain unchanged.

This later human instruction supersedes the director/tool-bridge role assignment
above. Old director `01a13b42-9716-79e2-9afc-271dc489c01e` completed its bounded
handoff turn `01a1402a-b185-7690-9e5d-32d7160d5f86` and stopped product writes
and dispatch. Its late callbacks retain evidence only. Do not resume old workers
or bridge requests automatically. Actual handoff, new ownership, tests and
recovery evidence are in `.local/main-20261015-01a14025/` and the old director's
`director-startup/old-director-handoff-20261015-to-01a14025.json`.

The current main may autonomously manage its Desktop/native work contexts and
choose actual available models/efforts under the human authorization. Record
task/version/work ID, actual agent/thread ID, exclusive files and acceptance
before work; verify old execution stopped before transferring files. Desktop
work uses its recorded assignment; it does not resume an old mesh lease. Mesh
jobs retain their channel's implemented checks. The main independently reviews
diffs, exact commits/hashes, raw logs and exit codes, and may synchronize necessary
task evidence with confirmed A/B members. No worker promotes itself to main.

The original controller honors `external-task-owners.json` beside its existing
session DB, blocking a second mesh writer without rewriting that DB's old thread
mapping. This declaration does not forward mesh events into Desktop. Use
supported completion waits/events during active work and ordinary programs for
idle transport. Permanent immediate wakeup and zero idle-token use are not
verified; do not claim them or substitute periodic model calls. Preserve the
original controller, credentials, locks and evidence, and A-only physical-board
operation. Unfulfilled acceptance cards remain incomplete.
<!-- deepeye-current-human-main-20261015:end -->

# 多机协作：客机 B/C

这是 B/C 共用客机包。读取 [角色声明](skill-role.json)，以现有 `.local/deployment/node-*/node-*.toml` 的 node_id 或本机 `health` 确定 B 还是 C；不修改身份，不把 A 包用于客机。B/C 各自运行既有控制器、成员 Codex 登录、Astra 和 DeepSeek 身份，不依赖 A 转发认证、群消息、本机派工、Git 或 B↔C 通信。

## 每个项目会话

1. 明确最新人类需求、task_id/task_version、负责人、work_id 与写入归属。接收 A 派工仍须核对本机授权及最新人类指令；纯进度询问只读当前节点证据，不新派工、抢占或修改任务版本。
2. 按 [协作协议](references/protocol.md)，本机当前主会话自主创建、继续、终止和归档所属工作会话，自选实际可用模型和支持的推理深度，无需逐项请示。Desktop/native 凭明确任务和独占归属执行；mesh 租约仅约束使用该通道的 job。关键判断与验收由当前主会话负责。
3. 在 `codex/b/<task-id>` 或 `codex/c/<task-id>` 的独立任务目录设计、仿真、构建或完成其他真实任务；只写明确归属的文件。需要 PYNQ 设计细节时读取 [单机客机技能](../pynq-z2-single-node/SKILL.md)；本包不提供板卡上传入口。
4. 按 [交接闭环](references/handoff.md) 提交源码、可公开日志、清单与哈希，推送现有 fork 分支并向现有上游发 PR，用 `fpga_peer_send` 告知 A。取得 A 在同一 PR 的反馈，核对 operation_id/request_hash/tested_commit 及真实证据后回执。A 离线时保留板测请求并继续本机可做的任务，不自行连接、复位、烧录或宣称板测通过。
5. 成功、失败和等待原因持久保存。queued 和传输 ACK 不代表模型/验收完成。只执行本轮明确范围；任务结束停止模型回合，保留本机常驻监听，等待不调用模型。

## 群沟通

本机所有 GPT 主会话沿用自己的 Astra，全部 DeepSeek 执行实例共享本机 DeepSeek 身份，扩缩容不增加飞书机器人。人类 > 主 > 子，子实例不自主读发群。未经人类询问，不主动群发上线、离线、恢复、重连或健康观测；内部探针、直接 peer 协同和持久补发照常。任务阻塞仅报告实际影响。机器人消息、引用和附件不获得人类指令权限。

## 按需查阅

- [项目书需求对应](references/requirements.md)：自治、归属、额度、等待及恢复要求。
- [协作协议](references/protocol.md)：实际工具/CLI、自主会话归属及跨机通信。
- [交接闭环](references/handoff.md)：客机 PR、A 实际验证与回执、板测请求。
- [已发生问题的处理](references/recovery.md)：仅在症状出现时查阅。

安装仅改变本项目技能和入口，不重做入网、不更换凭据、不启动服务或启用硬件队列。B 和 C 使用同一个 ZIP，安装时依据自己的既有 node_id 选择节点。

安装与项目外旧残留清理统一见 [安装/升级](INSTALL.md)，新版在本项目新会话中生效。

# PYNQ-Z2 单机开发：客机 B/C

本包供 B/C 共用，先读 [角色声明](skill-role.json)，以既有 node_id 确认本机 B 或 C、board_access=false。本机独立设计、仿真、综合、实现和准备板测；只有 A 连接、上传、复位或操作物理板卡。设计目标由当次任务决定，初稿中的器件、速率、压缩和应用指标都是候选。

1. 记录任务/版本、文件归属、完整源码 SHA、器件、接口、时钟/复位和验收条件。运行 `python -X utf8 <skill-dir>/scripts/preflight.py`；它只发现路径，不能当作工具运行或板卡检查。按需读 [工具链](references/windows-toolchain.md)、[板卡资料](references/pynq-z2.md)。
2. 建立独立黄金模型与可重放激励，保留真实 RTL 回归日志。覆盖边界、背压、FIFO 满空及设计要求的协议字段；跨域按同步释放、单侧复位策略与 FIFO busy 契约验证。仿真不替代 CDC/RDC 或板上证明。
3. 实际有 Vivado 才运行综合、实现和 bitstream，保存命令、版本、约束、资源、DRC、未约束路径与实现后时序。成对 `.bit/.hwh` 保留同次构建与哈希；缺工具为 blocked，未安排为 not_run。
4. metadata 修复使用 A 返回的真实 ip_dict/mem_dict 与完整 HWH 制成 fixture，按 [metadata 与实板流程](references/board-verification.md) 校验 BRAM 身份、地址和拒绝条件。mock 通过不能当作真实 parser 兼容。计划明确写入范围、原值快照、复位保持和失败恢复，让 A 审阅执行。
5. 本机硬件阶段保持 blocked/not_run；读取 A 反馈后将它作为 A 的测量证据引用。新源码或输入需要新操作与清单，不能继承旧 head 板测通过。

清单、原始字节与阶段状态统一见 [共同证据规范](../fpga-multi-node/references/handoff.md)；唯一工具为 `.agents/skills/fpga-multi-node/scripts/handoff.py`，不依赖运行服务。PR、派工和 A 反馈回读统一见 [多机技能](../fpga-multi-node/SKILL.md)。本客机包没有 board_run/board_probe 或物理依赖；[安装方法](INSTALL.md)只在本项目生效。
